rows.quote: The EMBL-EBI (GCST90014456) dataset included 329,533 individuals of European descent, with 5,459 psoriasis cases and 324,074 controls [18].
rows.coder_note: Rule B: the sentence gives the GWAS Catalog accession GCST90014456, which no dictionary row lists (it lies outside the one registered range, GCST90018563-GCST90019002); reference 18 (Glanville 2021) is not a dictionary source.

Rule I1: the passages give 'UK Biobank' with counts only (462,933 European individuals; 5,314 cases and 457,619 controls); reference 19 (Bycroft 2018) is the general cohort description and not a dictionary source; no accession, release or pipeline is named.
